SYSTEM OVERVIEW

At Sharptrax Technologies, our welding positioners are designed to enhance efficiency, precision, and safety in welding operations. These advanced positioning systems allow welders to rotate and tilt workpieces into the optimal position.

SPECIFICATIONS
Wide Load Capacity Range – Available from 50 kg to 20 tons.
Adjustable Center of Gravity – Engineered for 75 mm to 300 mm ranges.
Variable speed rotation with bi-directional foot pedal control.
Heavy-duty earthing mechanism to prevent damage to internal bearings.
